title: Ingestion and unified iteration (adapters → store)
description:
Milestone 2 of the Local Store Initiative (implements BOTSPY-047770): mine every registered adapter into the store, strictly read-only with respect to source data, then iterate the unified history out of the store. Ingestion drives the existing `Adapter` trait (discover() + open()) — zero adapter changes — writes normalized sessions, messages, and parts plus the FTS index in per-session transactions, dedups by first-report-wins (the chapter-1 rule), proves the sources untouched (digest before/after, the importer-contract precedent), and round-trips sessions losslessly. The first face of the one query interface lands here: lazy iteration over sessions, messages, and parts with the engine invisible. Turns `01_iteration.feature` and `05_ingest.feature` green.

Every task in this epic: work in your own worktree off origin/develop (unique path, e.g. /tmp/botspy-<task-id>-<short>), branch `feat/store-<short>`, PR to develop only — never main (GitFlow). Log milestone comments on the task; close only when its DoD is met. Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
